sentence: Perfection is achieved, not when there is nothing more to add, but when there is nothing left to take away.

source.author: Antoine de Saint-Exupéry
source.work: Wind, Sand and Stars (Terre des hommes)
source.detail: 法语原作《风沙星辰》/《人类的大地》，英译本常见此句

translation: 完美不是无可增添，而是无可删减。
grammar: 主干是 Perfection is achieved（被动语态：主语 + be + 过去分词），意思是“完美是被达成的”。
not when …, but when … 是对比结构，用两个 when 引导的时间状语从句说明“不是在……的时候，而是在……的时候”。两个分句结构对称：nothing more to add 对 nothing left to take away。
there is nothing more to add / there is nothing left to take away 都是 there be + 不定式作后置定语。to add、to take away 修饰 nothing，表示“可以再加的东西”“可以再拿走的东西”。left 是过去分词作后置定语，修饰 nothing，意为“剩下的”。

vocab.example: We are not aiming for perfection in the first bring-up.
The team achieved a stable baud rate after two days of debugging.

vocab.meaning: 没有什么可再添加的了
vocab.example: I have nothing more to add to the design review.

vocab.meaning: 拿走、删减；也可指带走的收获
vocab.example: If we take away the unused interrupts, the ISR becomes much clearer.
There is nothing left in the backlog for this sprint.

note: 写驱动和精简固件时特别应景：先跑通，再砍掉多余的抽象和分支，直到只剩必要的部分。
